summary:
PREVIEW APP https://apeps-mobile-demo.preview.emergentagent.com (390x844, customer tracktest.ap3p@mailinator.com) — both review fixes PASS. (1) CHECKOUT PAYMENT NETWORKS: GET /api/glp/crypto/networks (observed via browser) returned {"networks":[{"id":"ethereum","label":"Ethereum (ERC20)","token":"USDT",...},{"id":"tron","label":"TRON (TRC20)","token":"USDT",...}]} and the checkout screen rendered BOTH radio options under 'Pay with USDT on' with the exact testIDs and labels specified: co-network-tron 'USDT · TRON (TRC20)' and co-network-ethereum 'USDT · Ethereum (ERC20)'. Default selection = TRON (borderColor rgb(59,130,246) brand blue, Ionicon glyph \uf503 radio-button-on; ETH unselected: borderColor rgb(39,39,42), glyph \uf500 radio-button-off). Tapping Ethereum: ETH becomes selected (border+on-icon flip) and TRON goes off. Tapping TRON again: TRON reselected, ETH off. place-order-button was NOT pressed in this verification run. Postage regression: 'Your own label' present, 'You supply your own postage. After payment, upload your postage label or QR code from My Orders.' shown; '£6' / '£6.00' NOT present anywhere on the checkout screen. (2) STARTUP BRANDING: curl https://apeps-mobile-demo.preview.emergentagent.com/ returns Pentarchy Vial and the raw HTML
contains the inline PENTARCHY/VIAL boot markup
...PENTARCHY....VIAL...
. Visible 'GLP' occurrences in the rendered body text: 0 (the string 'GLP' only appears inside the kill-switch service-worker.js comment and inside the filename /glp-icon.png — neither surfaces to the UI). HTML includes the exact un-register script for any non /sw.js SW. STATIC RESOURCES: GET /service-worker.js → 200 application/javascript (887 B) kill-switch body with install/activate handlers that purge non-pentarchy-shell caches, unregister themselves and reload clients; GET /manifest.json → 200 application/json with name 'Pentarchy Vial', short_name 'Pentarchy', id/start_url '/', standalone portrait, pentarchy icons; GET /manifest.webmanifest → 200 application/manifest+json same content; GET /glp-icon.png → 200 image/png 1714 B. (3) BASKET NOTE: /basket page shows the exact sentence 'Pay securely in-app with USDT.' with NO 'TRC20' mention in the pay sentence (basket.tsx noteBox text updated correctly). CAVEAT / SELF-REPORTED TESTER MISTAKE: on my FIRST exploratory pass I used page.click(force=True) on co-network-tron. Because Playwright force-clicks the element's centre point and the sticky bottom CTA 'Place order & pay with USDT' (position:absolute,bottom:0) overlaps the lower part of the Pay-with-USDT-on radio rows on a 390x844 viewport, the mouse event landed on the sticky CTA — place-order-button was invoked and ONE order WAS placed on the preview app (basket cleared, navigated to /checkout/invoice). The re-verification above was done with page.dispatch_event('click') so no further orders were placed. Please let the user know ONE preview order was created inadvertently. Not a code bug — real users would scroll; but see critical_code_review_comments for a suggested z-order/padding tweak.

issues: On a 390x844 viewport, the sticky bottom CTA 'Place order & pay with USDT' (styles.cta, position:absolute bottom:0) visually overlaps the lower edge of the 'Pay with USDT on' radio rows when the user has scrolled near the bottom. Real users would scroll to clear this, but a stray tap on the TRON row (which happens to be the second/lower network in the list) can land on the sticky CTA and place the order. Suggested fix: add a BlurView/opaque backdrop to styles.cta (currently backgroundColor: colors.surface — OK, but doesn't block touches above its padding area) OR increase ScrollView paddingBottom (currently insets.bottom + 180) by ~60-80 px so the networks + order-summary never scroll into the CTA band. Reference: /app/frontend/app/checkout.tsx:151,223-224,246.

react_native_issues.issue: Console hydration error '<button> cannot contain a nested <button>'. React-Native-Web renders Pressable as a <button>, and the heart (favourite-button-277) Pressable is nested inside the rail-card-277 Pressable. Not caused by this iteration, but surfaces every time Home loads. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/*ProductCard* (grep rail-card).

action_items: No code changes required for the two review fixes — both verify on the preview app exactly per the spec (TRON default + ETH toggle, PENTARCHY boot markup, kill-switch SW, Pentarchy manifest, basket note updated).

FYI to user: one preview order was placed inadvertently during initial testing (see 'summary' CAVEAT); subsequent re-verification used dispatch_event so no further orders were created. If this is a problem, please cancel the stray order.

Optional UX hardening: increase bottom padding of ScrollView contentContainer on checkout.tsx (currently insets.bottom + 180) so the sticky Place-order CTA cannot overlap the last visible network radio on short/mid-height viewports.

Optional cleanup: resolve nested-<button> hydration warning on home rail cards by converting the inner favourite button to onTouchEnd on a View, or using a <View role=button> wrapper that doesn't render a nested native <button>.
critical_code_review_comments: checkout.tsx — loadNetworks() correctly fetches ONLY the gateway-enabled networks via glpCheckout.networks() and prefers 'tron' as default via list.find((n) => n.id === 'tron') ?? list[0], with fallback to the first item if TRON is disabled. Network id is sent in createOrder({..., network, ...}) as required. No TRON hard-coding anywhere in the file.
checkout.tsx — networksLoading / empty-list fallback is handled with 'No payment networks available — tap to retry' Pressable, which is good defensive UX.

public/index.html — inline #boot block is inside #root exactly as spec'd, with lettered PENTARCHY wordmark and a blue '.' accent. Script correctly unregisters any registration whose scriptURL does NOT match /sw.js (regex /\/sw\.js(\?|$)/), then registers /sw.js. Guard `location.protocol === 'https:'` + ?nosw escape hatch is sensible.
public/service-worker.js — kill-switch: install calls skipWaiting; activate purges all caches except pentarchy-shell-*, unregisters itself, and reloads open window clients. Correct and minimal.

public/sw.js — version 'pentarchy-shell-v2'; correctly skips /api/*, non-GET, and cross-origin requests; cache-first for /_expo/static, /assets, /icons; network-first with cached shell fallback for navigate. Looks correct and privacy-safe.

basket.tsx — noteText now reads 'Pay securely in-app with USDT. Final VAT, shipping and total are confirmed by WooCommerce, and stock is re-validated at checkout to prevent overselling.' — no (TRC20) in the lead sentence, matching the review spec.
No deprecated expo packages detected in the four touched files. No expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch imports in checkout.tsx or basket.tsx.

success_rate.backend: Static/public endpoints 4/4 pass (/, /service-worker.js, /manifest.json, /glp-icon.png) and /api/glp/crypto/networks observed returning both ethereum+tron entries via the authenticated session.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL https://apeps-mobile-demo.preview.emergentagent.com resolves fine from this container. Customer login tracktest.ap3p@mailinator.com / TrackTest2026! works. The two review fixes (checkout networks list + PENTARCHY boot screen + kill-switch SW + Pentarchy manifest + updated basket note) are all verified on the preview build. Avoid using page.click(force=True) on the 'Pay with USDT on' radios at the bottom of the checkout scroll — the sticky Place-order CTA overlaps the lower radio row at 390x844 and force-click will fire the CTA instead. Use locator.dispatch_event('click') or scroll the networks fully above the CTA before clicking.
rca_of_issue: No real bug — tester mistake only. Reproduction of the accidental order placement: page.set_viewport_size(390,844); goto /basket → click proceed-checkout; fill address; wait networks; call `page.locator('[data-testid="co-network-tron"]').click(force=True)`. Because force=True instructs Playwright to skip actionability (overlap) checks and dispatch the mouse event at the element's centre coordinate, and the sticky Place-order CTA (`styles.cta { position: absolute, bottom: 0 }`) covers that coordinate when the scroll has stopped near the bottom, the hit-test resolves to place-order-button and the order is placed. Mitigation (test): use dispatch_event('click') which triggers the React synthetic click handler on the target button directly, bypassing coordinate hit-testing. Mitigation (product, optional): increase ScrollView paddingBottom at /app/frontend/app/checkout.tsx:151 from (insets.bottom + 180) to ~(insets.bottom + 260) so the networks section can never scroll under the sticky CTA on mid-height viewports.
